ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K Max, so this would duplicate my streaming setup.
ItemID: 2; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try connected home security that works with my Alexa devices and extends beyond my door alarms.
ItemID: 3; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently added a second-generation Show 5 and its stand, so I have little reason to buy the older model.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My fourth-generation Dot already fills this role, and I have no immediate need for another speaker.
ItemID: 5; Title: All-new Fire HD 10 tablet, 10.1", 1080p Full HD, 32 GB, latest model (2021 release), Black, without lockscreen ads; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try a larger portable screen for entertainment alongside my Fire TV and Alexa devices.
ItemID: 6; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The screen and storage appeal to me, but I would choose the newer HD 10 on this page this time.
ItemID: 7; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger Alexa display interests me, but my recent Show 5 purchase makes another display a lower priority.
ItemID: 8; Title: Amazon Fire HD 8 tablet, 8" HD display, 64 GB, (2020 release), designed for portable entertainment, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Portable entertainment fits my interests, but I would pick the larger HD 10 rather than buy two tablets.
ItemID: 9; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with clock and Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The clock is useful, but it is too similar to the Twilight Blue fourth-generation Dot I already have to choose now.
ItemID: 10; Title: Blink Mini – Compact indoor plug-in smart security camera, 1080p HD video, night vision, motion detection, two-way audio, easy set up, Works with Alexa – 3 cameras (Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa-compatible cameras interest me, but I would start with the whole-home bundle before adding three indoor cameras.
